title: Add reusable parameter-bound bundle presets for multi-section migration
description: Users materialize a generic multi-section preset into their own authorized definitions and execute it with existing bundle engine. Add shared customer/date/status parameter binding and trusted section templates to support existing customer report packets and receipt reconciliation outputs as template compositions, not dedicated endpoints/exporters. Stage 2 only. Preserve every existing route until ALL fixed/dynamic migrations have actual data, permission and Excel/PDF compatibility. No dedicated report controller/designer/exporter, arbitrary SQL/identifiers/joins, production operations, schema/seed/migration changes, secrets/env changes or permission expansion. Keep existing Domain/Application/Infrastructure/Api layering. Real writes in tests only after guard (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance and NEWERP_AUTOTEST_*; missing legacy schema/browser acceptance is an accurate environment blocker, not passed parity.
acceptance_criteria: Provide immutable bounded bundle preset catalog, previewable section metadata and materialization over existing generic datasets/presets. Include at least customer-report-packet sales-order/receivable composition and receipt-reconciliation order/unlinked-receipt composition with original section labels/order/column choices. Declare prerequisites/readiness independently for each legacy key; no presence-only parity-passed flags.

Bind only finite typed shared customer/date/status parameters validated against EVERY authorized section field catalog; reject mismatched or unsupported bindings before persisting. Customer packet requires original sales-order plus customer permission and current customer visibility; materialized definitions remain current-user private with pinned/shared access still enforced at execution. All-or-nothing materialization cleans up only new private drafts on failure; no broad deletion, cross-user edits or expansion of permissions.

Expose generic bundle-preset selection, finite parameters, materialize/preview/download with existing bundle service and generic Excel/PDF. Preserve independent currency/unit/evidence and legacy packet/receipt section provenance; errors/denials bounded and audited. Verify two template families, private ownership, unknown/revoked parameters/menus, rollback and genuine guarded SQL nonempty sections/output; run focused tests and safe Release build/unit suite. Keep old entries and all compatibility limitations until whole inventory actual acceptance.
implementation_evidence: Verified CustomerReportPacketController.cs and CustomerReportPacketDtos.cs compose bounded customerId/startDate/endDate sales and invoice/receipt sections through existing service. ERP307 introduces stateless definition-ID bundles only; no template catalog, shared typed parameter binding or multi-definition materialization. Receipt original two-section output cannot be represented by reduced single preset; ERP309 supplies independent bounded evidence catalog prerequisite. Existing immutable ReportConfigurationPresetCatalog and registry can host controlled readiness, not fabricated compatibility.
